weak_claims_for_deep_research.deep_research_question: Verify BPJS Kesehatan employer contribution rates and salary cap directly from: (a) Peraturan Presiden (Presidential Regulation) No. 64 Tahun 2020 on JKN contribution rates — available at jdih.kemenkeu.go.id; (b) BPJS Kesehatan official FAQ on iuran (contribution) at bpjs-kesehatan.go.id/bpjs/pages/detail/2014/18; (c) Peraturan BPJS Kesehatan on employer registration.

stage_diversity.diversity_note: The stage cites well over 8 unique publishers (31 enumerated domains), exceeding the Tier 2 minimum floor of 8 unique publishers. However, quality-adjusted diversity is moderate: a significant portion of unique publishers are secondary aggregators (Databoks, Worldometer, Mordor, Grand View, Snapcart, Knoema), auto-low social media (Twitter/X), unverifiable-access sources (BCG, McKinsey), and HR compliance blogs. Primary-tier diversity is strong for the academic/NCD evidence base but weaker for market sizing and insurance market claims. The count of ≥8 unique publishers is passed; the depth flag is that only ~8 of the 23+ publishers are primary-tier.
